title: Atlas DataFlow Inference Bundle
description: Schema defining the inference-bundle family. inference_bundle.v1 (unchanged in meaning) is the release-oriented contract that turns a governed trained tabular model artifact into an executable runtime bundle -- it links model loading details, contract references, training provenance, hashes, feature order, preprocessing behavior, output schema, and compatibility constraints without embedding raw model bytes, notebook state, private paths, or duplicated runtime payload validation semantics. inference_bundle.v2 (Project Spec S0245) is a strict, disjoint, forecasting-only branch for Atlas-native univariate forecasting: it carries a reduced frozen-model descriptor and forecasting-specific provenance instead of feature_order/preprocessing, and structurally forbids external_model_evidence. Closed discriminated union keyed by contract_version; a document must validate against exactly one branch -- a document mixing v1 and v2 fields, or declaring an unknown contract_version, matches neither branch and is rejected.

allOf.description: Project Spec S0157: training_evidence (Atlas internal-training-run-shaped) remains required for every historical bundle and every bundle that omits model_provenance_origin or declares it atlas_internal_training -- unchanged default behavior. A bundle explicitly declaring model_provenance_origin: validated_external_fitted_model must carry external_model_evidence instead, and must never also carry training_evidence, so an external fitted-model origin can never be paired with an Atlas internal training-run identity.

contract_version.description: Fixed contract version for the first inference bundle schema iteration.

bundle_id.description: Stable generated bundle identifier tied to the dataset slug and generation timestamp.

example_only.description: May be true only for fixtures under contracts/examples/. Production generated bundles should omit this field or set it to false.

path.description: Release-relative path to the serialized model artifact. Absolute paths, parent traversal, and internal local paths are invalid.

execution_strategy.description: Governed dispatch strategy. Omission preserves the historical in-process behavior for inference_bundle.v1 artifacts, and an explicit "in_process" is the canonical current declaration. Project Spec S0285: "isolated_service" is retained ONLY as historical inference_bundle.v1 structural vocabulary for backward compatibility -- it does NOT exist as a currently admitted Atlas execution topology. The Publisher rejects any new candidate whose predictive bundle declares it, and the main Atlas API fails closed (no HTTP dispatch, no second service) if a bundle is ever encountered with it at runtime. Schema validity of this value alone never authorizes isolated-service execution.

serialization_format.description: Bounded serialization format vocabulary. The first implementation-ready format follows M24 serializer output.

loader_strategy.description: Bounded runtime loader strategy. Arbitrary import paths, executable strings, or notebook callbacks are not valid.

model_family.description: Project Spec S0209 adds decision_tree, bounded to the validated external fitted-model v2 estimator-identity pairing -- never selectable by internal Atlas training.

runtime_profile.description: Project Spec S0285: legacy/deprecated structural syntax. Historical inference_bundle.v1 compatibility only, paired with the retired execution_strategy=isolated_service vocabulary. Not a currently admitted Atlas runtime topology; a new candidate declaring it is rejected by the Publisher and never dispatched by the API.

runtime_contract_reference.description: Pointer to the canonical runtime contract reference in this bundle. Payload validation semantics remain owned by contracts/runtime-contract.schema.json.

input_policy_source.description: Project Spec S0156: optional, backward-compatible explicit confirmation that input normalization (conditional blank-input policies) and categorical acceptance semantics (known_values/validation_behavior) are owned exclusively by the referenced runtime contract and must be honored before model invocation. Never a second, independently editable copy of those rules. Historical bundles omit this field and remain valid; only newly generated bundles for datasets using the new input-policy vocabulary need to set it.

feature_order.description: Ordered governed feature/source-column identities passed to the model after runtime payload validation and preprocessing.

source.description: Preprocessing behavior must be traced to governed contract/training artifacts rather than notebook memory.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0108: optional, backward-compatible normalized binary-result release metadata. Present only on newly generated binary bundles whose execution contract carries a reviewed, materialized result_semantics; absent (never null) for historical bundles. Project Spec S0209 closes this into a binary/multiclass union -- exactly one of binary_result_semantics or multiclass_result_semantics may match, both additionalProperties: false with disjoint required-field shapes. Project Spec S0225 closes this further into a binary/multiclass/continuous-regression union by adding continuous_regression_result_semantics -- never a positive/negative class, classes, a probability output, a threshold, a decision strategy, or an interpretation/risk band. Strictly validated when present.

model_provenance_origin.description: Project Spec S0157: optional, backward-compatible explicit model-provenance declaration for this bundle. Absent (the default for every historical bundle) or atlas_internal_training keeps the existing training_evidence-based shape unchanged. validated_external_fitted_model switches the required provenance block to external_model_evidence and forbids training_evidence on the same bundle. S0157 does not make the current Atlas runtime consume a validated_external_fitted_model bundle -- runtime architecture and load-safe implementation belong to later specs.

external_model_evidence.description: Project Spec S0157: present only when model_provenance_origin is validated_external_fitted_model. Carries external fitted-model provenance and educational-vs-operational readiness evidence. Never present on a bundle that also carries training_evidence. Project Spec S0209 closes this into a v1 (threshold-oriented, unchanged) / v2 (ordered multiclass classification evidence, argmax decision) union -- exactly one may match.

inference_bundle_v2.description: Project Spec S0245: strict, closed inference_bundle.v2 branch for Atlas-native univariate forecasting. Disjoint from inference_bundle_v1 -- structurally forbids feature_order, preprocessing, and external_model_evidence (additionalProperties: false and no such property is declared). model_provenance_origin is fixed to atlas_internal_training. Never carries actual future forecast periods/values, the full expanding-window fold schedule, raw history/target/forecast arrays, or a confidence/prediction interval contract.

contract_version.description: Fixed contract version for the Atlas-native univariate-forecasting inference bundle branch.

bundle_id.description: Stable generated bundle identifier tied to the dataset slug and generation timestamp.

example_only.description: May be true only for fixtures under contracts/examples/. Production generated bundles should omit this field or set it to false.

contract_references.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change D: the generic contract-reference bridge is preserved unchanged in shape; only the execution_contract reference is pinned to execution_contract.v2. No concrete forecasting runtime/public schema structure is imposed here -- only the declared version/hash/reference.

prepared_dataset.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change F: reduced prepared-series provenance, equivalent to v1. Never embeds raw rows, target values, future holdout values, or full dataset contents.

preparation_evidence.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change E: lineage/audit evidence only. The future runtime adapter must not require opening this artifact.

training_evidence.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change G: strict forecasting training evidence. model_selection_evidence must be absent or fixed to null -- no external fitted-model evidence may satisfy v2.

frozen_model.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change H: a normalized frozen-model projection only. No field is independently caller-authored when it can be sourced from governed upstream evidence.

path.description: Release-relative path to the serialized frozen model artifact. Absolute paths, parent traversal, and internal local paths are invalid.

seasonal_period.description: Explicit, dataset-specific governed seasonal period. Must never be hardcoded to a dataset-specific constant by this schema itself.

reference_season_position.description: Explicit, dataset-specific reference seasonal indicator position.

training_scope.description: Development-partition scope, projected from the authenticated preparation recipe. Never the full fold schedule.

runtime_execution.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change M: compatibility metadata only. Never implements trusted model loading, history normalization, design-matrix construction at runtime, forecast execution, or API dispatch -- those belong to a later spec.

input_schema.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change N: history-series input compatibility identity. Never carries an independently editable required history length, period parser, gap policy, missing-value policy, column list, or user-supplied horizon -- those belong to the referenced runtime contract.

output_schema.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change O: forecasting output compatibility identity. Never defines concrete runtime/API field names such as period, forecast, or forecast_origin -- a later spec owns the actual runtime result schema.

compatibility_constraints.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change Q. Never requires requires_feature_order_match -- structurally excluded by additionalProperties: false.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0245 Desired Change P: strict forecasting bundle result semantics. Required on every inference_bundle.v2 document -- forecasting has no result-semantics-optional tabular fallback. Never contains actual forecast points.

display_name.description: Deterministic projection of model_family via a fixed code mapping. Never editable profile copy.

model_provenance_origin.description: Project Spec S0245: fixed on every inference_bundle.v2 document. external_model_evidence is forbidden on v2 -- structurally excluded by additionalProperties: false.

isolated_runtime_profile.description: Project Spec S0285: legacy/deprecated, operationally unsupported structural vocabulary. Retained so historical inference_bundle.v1 documents that once described isolated-service dispatch remain parseable and structurally valid -- S0285 does not pretend this syntax never existed. It confers no operational permission: the Publisher rejects new candidates that carry it and the main Atlas API process never delegates to a second inference service.

release_relative_path.description: Portable path relative to the release package root. Absolute paths, parent traversal, repeated separators, URI schemes, drive letters, and shell metacharacters are not valid.

result_schema_version.description: Identifies the future binary response family this release's metadata is compatible with; created by S0108, produced by S0109.

bands.description: Ordered, contiguous, non-overlapping risk bands covering [0, 1] exactly: low, medium, high, each once. Interval semantics are lower_bound <= probability < upper_bound, except the final band's upper bound 1.0 is inclusive. Full ordering/contiguity is enforced by the materialization pipeline, not by this schema alone.

display_name.description: Deterministic projection of model_family via a fixed code mapping. Never editable profile copy.

estimator_identity.description: Project Spec S0157: bounded structured estimator identity for the v1 external evidence branch. Never an arbitrary module import path or callable string.

estimator_identity_v2.description: Project Spec S0209: bounded structured estimator identity for the v2 multiclass external evidence branch. Never an arbitrary module import path or callable string; the library/class_name pairing is cross-checked against model_family by external_family_estimator_pair_v2 below.

external_family_estimator_pair_v2.description: Project Spec S0209: closes the v2 model_family/estimator_identity pairing so a cross-paired combination (e.g. model_family=random_forest with class_name=LogisticRegression) is rejected. Mirrors pipeline/training-parameter-record.schema.json's external_family_estimator_pair_v2.

multiclass_classification_evidence_v2.description: Project Spec S0209: governed multiclass classification evidence claim propagated verbatim in governed order from S0208 external evidence. Not proof from model deserialization.

multiclass_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0209: strict multiclass release result semantics, mirroring contracts/execution-contract.schema.json's Project Spec S0207 multiclass_result_semantics plus a deterministic model_descriptor (analogous to binary_result_semantics.model_descriptor). Never defines a positive/negative class, a threshold, or a risk interpretation -- those remain exclusively binary_result_semantics concepts.

result_schema_version.description: Identifies the future multiclass response family this release's metadata is compatible with. Project Spec S0209 does not create or implement the runtime response payload for that version.

classes.description: The complete, normatively ordered set of governed classes. Array order is normative and must never be sorted or re-derived.

model_family.description: Bounded to the four Project Spec S0208 external fitted-model v2 estimator families -- multiclass bundle generation in Project Spec S0209 has no internal Atlas training source.

display_name.description: Deterministic projection of model_family via a fixed code mapping. Never editable profile copy.

continuous_regression_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0225: strict continuous-regression release result semantics, mirroring contracts/execution-contract.schema.json's Project Spec S0223 continuous_regression_result_semantics plus a deterministic model_descriptor (analogous to binary_result_semantics.model_descriptor and multiclass_result_semantics.model_descriptor). Never defines a positive/negative class, classes, a probability output, a threshold, a decision strategy, an interpretation/risk band, count/exposure/offset semantics, or a multi-output target -- those remain exclusively binary/multiclass concepts.

result_schema_version.description: Identifies the future continuous-regression response family this release's metadata is compatible with. Project Spec S0225 does not create or implement the runtime response payload for that version -- see Project Spec S0226.

model_family.description: Bounded to the Project Spec S0224/S0232 Atlas-native fixed-configuration continuous-regression model families -- continuous-regression bundle generation has no external fitted-model source.

display_name.description: Deterministic projection of model_family via a fixed code mapping. Never editable profile copy.

external_model_evidence_v1.description: Project Spec S0157: validated external fitted-model provenance and educational-vs-operational readiness evidence. S0157 does not make the current Atlas runtime consume this profile.

model_state_fingerprint.description: Must be consistent with the same fingerprint carried by the corresponding external model-selection-evidence and training-parameter-record evidence. A mismatch across those references is rejected.

educational_threshold.description: An educational decision threshold retained as evidence -- structurally distinct from any future operational threshold, never mislabeled operational, and always selected on the validation partition (never test).

allOf.description: operational_prediction_available = true is rejected when operational_validity is unconfirmed.

external_model_evidence_v2.description: Project Spec S0209: validated external fitted-model v2 (multiclass) provenance and argmax decision/readiness evidence, mirroring pipeline/external-fitted-model-materialization.schema.json's materialized_result_v2. Never carries educational_threshold, operational_threshold, positive_class, or risk bands -- those remain exclusively v1 (binary) concepts.

model_state_fingerprint.description: Must be consistent with the same fingerprint carried by the corresponding external model-selection-evidence and training-parameter-record evidence. A mismatch across those references is rejected.

classification_evidence.description: The normalized/cross-checked multiclass classification evidence, propagated verbatim in governed order from the agreeing S0208 external evidence.

allOf.description: operational_prediction_available = true is rejected when operational_validity is unconfirmed.
